title: grep
summary: Search the source tree with a regular expression.
purpose: Search the source tree with a regular expression.

fields.name: pattern
fields.description: Regular expression to find (Python re syntax).

fields.name: path
fields.description: Directory where the search starts. Empty means the entire source root.

fields.name: max_results
fields.description: Maximum matches to return. Once filled, scanning stops after that file.

fields.name: ref
fields.description: Optional committed-tree ref. Omit or send null for the worktree, including uncommitted changes. Accepts head, target_sha, merge_base and merge_tree from merge_preview.

details: Replace {name} in the route with path_parameters.name.
Do not edit the project source on disk directly — every source read and change goes through these tools.
total is exact only when truncated=false; when true, it is a lower bound at the point scanning stopped.
.venv / venv / node_modules / .git / __pycache__ are excluded from traversal. Point path directly into one to inspect it.
Very large and binary files are skipped.

errors.when: The path does not exist or is not a directory.
The regular expression is invalid or path escapes the source root.
This token does not have the grep scope.
